# Route → API → Service → Persistence Coverage

**Date:** 2026-10-21. Generated by reading `src/App.js`, `src/lib/footballApi.js`, every
`src/pages/*.js`, and by capturing **every** XHR/fetch issued by each route in a real browser
session against the running stack. "Observed" = the request was captured in the browser;
"probed" = it was also called directly against the API with a signed admin JWT.

## 2. Backend surface (156 endpoints, 11 routers)

| Router | Prefix | Endpoints | Auth | Demo-gated |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `routes_canonical.py` | `/api/v1` | 67 | bearer (router-level) | no |
| `routes_phase10.py` | `/api/phase10` | 30 | bearer | no (one endpoint self-gates) |
| `routes_phase11.py` | `/api/phase11` | 17 | bearer | **yes** |
| `routes_phase12.py` | `/api/phase12` | 16 | bearer | **yes** |
| `routes_phase13.py` | `/api/v1/decision-lab` | 16 | bearer | **yes** |
| `routes_phase14.py` | `/api/v1/outcomes` | 15 | bearer | **yes** |
| `routes_phase15.py` | `/api/v1/research` | 19 | bearer | no |
| `routes_phase16.py` | (root) | 29 | bearer | no |
| `routes_data_coverage.py` | `/api/data-coverage` | 5 | bearer | no |
| `routes_ingestion.py` | `/api/v1/ingestion` | 2 | bearer | no |
| `routes_admin.py` | `/api/v1/admin` | 1 | bearer | no |
| `main.py` | app root | 10 | mixed (`/health`, `/readiness` public) | no |

Authentication is enforced at the router level (`app.include_router(..., dependencies=_AUTHENTICATED)`),
so every endpoint above rejects unauthenticated calls. Verified directly:

```
GET http://127.0.0.1:8002/api/v1/players/search?page=1&page_size=1  -> 401 {"detail":"authentication required"}
GET http://127.0.0.1:8004/api/phase10/recruitment/projects           -> 401 {"detail":"authentication required"}
```

## 3. Known route/coverage gaps

| Gap | Detail |
|---|---|
| Unused canonical endpoints | `/api/v1/players/{id}/intelligence`, `/api/v1/market/dataset-preview`, `/api/v1/decisions/{id}/evidence`, `/api/v1/operations/*` (phase16), `/api/data-coverage/*` are not called by any frontend page. They are reachable and authenticated, but not surfaced in the UI. |
| `roles` N+1 | 80 per-player requests per page load (see `SIDEBAR_MODULE_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md`, O1). |
| No endpoint returns a players count for `/api/v1/players` | The legacy list has no total by design; the canonical total is `/api/v1/players/search`. The data-quality page therefore reports a 5-row sample, not the count. |
| `matches` list has no total | `GET /api/v1/matches?limit=50` is bounded and un-paginated; the Matches module therefore cannot show a true total. |
